description: Conformance examples for profile logic. Block identities and decoded transaction effects are synthetic inputs, not mainnet block proofs or signed transactions. Predicate addresses are checksum-valid synthetic HASH160 encodings; no private-key ownership is asserted. Implementations must independently validate their actual chain and transaction data.

acceptedChainCases.expectedHistoricalCoverage: rebuild all newly eligible records, not only replacement blocks

reorganizationPolicy: Only acceptedBlocks govern the derived state. Previously accepted/orphaned blocks and observed unconfirmed transactions are audit/test observations and must not mutate the accepted result. eventStage fields are synthetic already-derived stages; calendar/stage derivation is checked by the separate stage fixtures.
recoveryRetentionSemantics: Each case is a removal authorization check on the current accepted view, not a claim of finality. Require an accepted-ancestor retirement anchor, acceptedTipHeight-retirementHeight >= max(100, configuredRetentionBlocks), no live-state or recovery dependency, and a verified deeper-reorganization reconstruction path. Configurations below 100 are invalid. Previously observed or rejected heights are audit inputs only. A previously purged record made necessary by a deeper reorganization must be reconstructed, with unavailable responses until verified.
